lessons.title: The Logic of the True Experiment
lessons.description: Unlock the gold standard of causal inference: IV manipulation, experimental control, and random assignment vs. random sampling.

lessons.title: Between-Subjects vs. Within-Subjects Designs
lessons.description: Compare independent groups against repeated measures designs: statistical power, individual differences, and matched pairs.

lessons.title: Controlling Order & Carryover Effects
lessons.description: Neutralize practice, fatigue, and carryover effects using complete counterbalancing, partial counterbalancing, and Latin Square matrices.

lessons.title: Threats to Internal Validity
lessons.description: Master Campbell & Stanley's classic threats: history, maturation, testing, regression to the mean, attrition, and double-blind controls.
